# S5 Extension architecture

SYSTEM · S5

# Extension architecture

A small trusted core, a narrow permission-checked API, and extensions isolated in their own sandboxes. They add to slots; they never reach the page.

## Core TRUSTED

Small, stable, versioned with the app
Reading engine parse · sanitise · paginate · anchors (CFI)
UI shell chrome · Navigator · popovers · selection bar
Library store books · progress · metadata
Annotation store highlights · notes · Web Annotation JSON
Search index background worker · persisted

## Host API v1

async · structured messages · semver · checked against the manifest on every call
commands.register none
selection.addAction none
navigator.addTab none
themes.contribute none
book.selection() book.selection
book.text(range) book.text
annotations.list / on annotations.read
net.fetch(url) network:host
files.save(dialog) files.export
**Watchdog** · 2 s UI / 10 s work timeouts · CPU and memory budgets · 3 crashes in 10 min → suspended · safe mode (⇧ at launch)

## Extension host UNTRUSTED

One sandbox per extension · lazy activation · unloaded when idle
**Markdown Export**
Worker · logic, no DOM
No UI
annotations.read files.export
**Dictionary**
Worker · lookup
Sandboxed frame · Navigator tab, style kit
book.selection network: api.dictionaryapi.dev
**Night Owl**
Token JSON only
No code, no permissions
Slots ⌘K commands Selection “⋯” menu Navigator tab Theme list Export menu Annotation & session events Never DOM in page overlays on text toolbar icons core shortcuts
